title: WantedX
description: A Vanilla like feature-rich bounty hunting plugin for Paper servers with contracts, tracking, survival objectives, revenge mechanics, and anti-abuse features.
body:
WantedX

WantedX is a vanilla-friendly Paper plugin that adds an item-based bounty system to your Minecraft SMP. Instead of using an economy plugin or virtual currency, players place bounties using real Minecraft items from their own inventory, creating meaningful rewards and player-driven stories.

Whether you’re running a small private SMP or a larger survival server, WantedX encourages exploration, rivalries, teamwork, and exciting player hunts while keeping the gameplay feeling like vanilla Minecraft.

Features

* 🎯 Item-Based Bounties
    * Place bounties using real Minecraft items instead of money.
    * Rewards are taken directly from the player placing the bounty.
* 👤 Player Head Bounty Board
    * Browse available bounty targets through an easy-to-use GUI.
    * Select players directly from their player heads.
* 📦 Real Reward Delivery
    * When a wanted player is eliminated, the killer receives the exact items that were offered as the bounty.
* 📍 Last Seen Tracking
    * Track wanted players using a vanilla-friendly “Last Seen” system.
    * Displays general location information such as biome or nearby landmarks instead of exact coordinates, encouraging players to hunt rather than teleport directly to a target.
* 📊 Player Statistics
    * View your personal bounty statistics, including bounties placed, bounties claimed, times you’ve been wanted, and more.
* ⚙️ Highly Configurable
    * Customize cooldowns, bounty limits, expiration times, tracking behavior, blacklisted items, announcements, and more to fit your server.
* 🛡️ Vanilla SMP Focus
    * No economy plugin required.
    * Designed to blend naturally into survival gameplay without feeling like a minigame.

Perfect For

* Survival SMPs
* Friends-only servers
* Content creators
* Community servers looking to create player-driven events and memorable stories

WantedX is designed to make every bounty feel meaningful by using real items, balanced tracking, and simple mechanics that fit naturally into Minecraft’s survival experience.
